items.title: Lee Collins Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Oh, I heard, yeah, Manuel Moneta talking about it. And Manuel Moneta was in the band. [INTERVIEWEE] Udell Wilson, Inez Trepani on drum... All but Manuel. Manuel looked fine last time I said it.

ctx.x: You want to turn it off for a minute, Lee? No, you got to turn it off for a minute. Okay. Yeah, it's going again now, Lee.

So, this entertainer was run by two Sicilians, Johnny Latters and Joe Latters. Used to be named Old Hunt and One Ranch where Joe Oliver used to play. Yeah. And all the good boys in the good old days. Packed every night, packed every night. We'd close everything down in that part. So, I got tangled up. I can tell it now because it's a long time, it's been a long time. I got tangled up with all the awful friends, girl that time. My name was Albertine. And so, everybody was telling stories at that time about…
